@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Libre+Caslon+Display&display=swap');
:root{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;color:#233f37;background:#f8f5ee;font-synthesis:none}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}a:hover{text-decoration:underline}header{border-bottom:1px solid #d9ded2;padding:24px 5vw;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.brand{font:40px 'Libre Caslon Display',Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-2px}header nav{display:flex;gap:32px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}main{max-width:1400px;padding:40px 5vw 90px;margin:auto}h1{font:clamp(48px,6vw,82px)/1.02 'Libre Caslon Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;margin:14px 0 25px;letter-spacing:-1px}h2{font-size:18px;font-weight:500;margin:12px 0}p{line-height:1.65}.eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:700}.hero{padding:25px 0 44px;max-width:780px}.hero>p:last-child{max-width:460px;color:#65736a}.filters{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:end;padding:24px;background:#eaece1;border-radius:3px}.filters label:first-child{flex:1}label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}input,select{font:inherit;border:1px solid #c9d1c2;border-radius:3px;padding:13px 14px;background:#fffefa;color:#233f37;min-height:45px}button,.button{background:#234d40;color:#fffefa;border:0;border-radius:3px;padding:15px 20px;font:500 13px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;display:inline-block;text-align:center;min-height:45px}button:hover,.button:hover{background:#366a56;text-decoration:none}button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}.secondary{background:#e3e8dc;color:#234d40}.subtle{background:transparent;color:#7c4a36;padding:10px;text-decoration:underline}.subtle:hover{background:#eee6da}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:35px 25px}.product h2{font-size:17px}.product p{margin:8px 0}.image-wrap{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#e9e5da;aspect-ratio:4/3}.product img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .25s}.product a:hover img{transform:scale(1.025)}.badge{position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;padding:5px 10px;background:#fffefa;color:#756d60;font-size:11px}.muted{color:#788074;font-size:13px}.paging{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:24px;align-items:center;margin-top:45px;font-size:13px}.back{display:block;margin:5px 0 30px;font-size:13px}.detail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:65px;align-items:center}.detail>img{width:100%;background:#ece8df}.detail h1{font-size:60px}.detail form{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:15px;margin:30px 0}.detail input{width:90px}.price{font-size:23px}.cart-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr;gap:50px;margin-top:40px}.cart-line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 85px 80px auto;gap:15px;align-items:center;padding:25px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d8dfd0}.cart-line input{width:80px}.cart-line p{font-size:12px;margin:4px 0}aside{background:#eaece1;padding:30px;align-self:start}aside h2{margin-top:0}.totals p{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:14px}.grand{border-top:1px solid #cad3c1;padding-top:16px;font-size:19px!important}aside form{margin:25px 0;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-direction:column}aside .button{display:block}#checkout{max-width:440px}#checkout button{width:100%;margin-top:20px}#notice{max-width:1260px;margin:15px auto;padding:0 5vw;color:#955232;min-height:20px;font-size:14px}footer{padding:32px 5vw;border-top:1px solid #d9ded2;color:#788074;font-size:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}.success{padding:50px 0}.success strong{overflow-wrap:anywhere}:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #bd724b;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:900px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.detail{gap:30px}.cart-layout{gap:25px}.cart-line{grid-template-columns:1fr 80px}.cart-line b{font-size:13px}}@media(max-width:650px){header{padding:20px 6vw}.brand{font-size:34px}header nav{gap:18px}main{padding:20px 6vw 60px}.hero{padding:15px 0 30px}.filters{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:14px;padding:18px}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:25px 14px}.product h2{font-size:15px}.product .eyebrow{font-size:9px}.detail,.cart-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:25px}.detail h1{font-size:48px}.paging{gap:12px}.paging button{padding:12px}aside{padding:24px}.cart-line{gap:10px}footer{gap:20px}.success h1{font-size:54px}}
